title: Alien communication device
body:
Alien Communication Device

"A rare device that sends a remote call to the aliens. Be careful, they're not very friendly! Has a cool down of 1 hour, and consumes 300 energy on use. Must be recharged at an Energy Vault."

As said, this device needs to be charged with 300 energy after each use. Spawns alien crash site.

Method of Obtainment

You will receive the device after completing the Alien orb quest and can only be given by such. To obtain the Alien Communication Device you must find and enter the Alien Ruins and speak to Alan Burk's Hologram. After obtaining the quest, locate the three missing alien orbs and return them to their pedestals. After you finish this quest you will obtain the Alien Communication Device with one use already loaded onto it.
